english.note: Use this for the broader salon treatment of the feet, including care beyond just the toenails.

examples.english: The pedicure at this beauty salon is very comprehensive, including dead skin and the soles of the feet.
examples.traditional: 呢間美容院嘅足部護理好全面，連死皮同腳底都會照顧。
